tagline: A JavaScript end-to-end runner with its own browser-embedded UI.
scenario: Open a page, click a link, type into a field and assert what it contains.
notes: Both wait automatically; neither needs an explicit sleep.
Browser puts the assertion inside the keyword — Get Text reads and checks in one line.
Cypress runs inside the browser; Browser drives it from outside via Playwright.
Cypress supports Chromium-family browsers and Firefox; Browser also drives WebKit.
